title: Tennis Map court import file
description: The file an AI agent produces for a human to review and upload at Courts → Import in the Tennis Map admin. It is validated by POST /v1/admin/courts/import (dry run by default). Every court is created as a DRAFT, PREMIUM (isLocked) court with no photos — an admin adds photos and publishes by hand afterwards.

courts.description: 1 to 50 courts. If you have more than 50, split them into several files/imports.

name.description: The court/venue's real name, as it is publicly known (e.g. the hotel or club name). Plain text — no HTML.

slug.description: Leave this out — the server generates a URL-safe slug from "name" automatically. Only set it if you were explicitly told a specific slug to use.

country.description: The country the court is in. If this country already exists in Tennis Map, these values are matched by isoCode and the existing country is reused — get the isoCode right.

name.description: The country's common English name, e.g. "France", "Monaco", "United Arab Emirates".

isoCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "FR", "MC", "AE". Case does not matter — the server upper-cases it. This is the field used to detect "this country already exists", so double-check it against an authoritative ISO list rather than guessing.

continent.description: One of the five vocabulary values — use "Americas" for both North and South America, "Oceania" for Australia/NZ/Pacific.

region.description: The city or local area the court is in, e.g. "Roquebrune-Cap-Martin", "Dubai". Not the country — that is a separate field. If this region does not already exist under this country, a new one is created using THIS COURT's own lat/lng as the region's map position.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84, at most 7 decimal places. Must not be exactly 0 together with lng=0 (treated as "no real location"). Take this from the venue's own pin on Google Maps/OpenStreetMap — never the city centre.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84, at most 7 decimal places. See "lat" for the sourcing rule.

mapLinkUrl.description: The venue's Google Maps link (https:// only — google.com/maps, maps.google.com, goo.gl/maps, or any maps.app.goo.gl link). This is the link shown to a logged-in member as "Directions", so it must be the REAL link for this venue, not a generic map search. Omit or set null if you don't have one.

surface.description: The court's playing surface. See AGENT_PROMPT.md for how to tell these apart from venue marketing copy.

access.description: Who can play there. See AGENT_PROMPT.md for the exact meaning of each value.

indoorOutdoor.description: Whether the court is indoor or outdoor. If genuinely unknown, use "Outdoor" — it is the far more common case for the venues this project lists.

setting.description: A SHORT phrase describing the court's setting, shown on its card, e.g. "Hilltop clay courts above the sea" or "Terraced courts on a Riviera hillside". Not a sentence, not marketing copy — a factual phrase.

isScenic.description: True if the court has a notable scenic view/setting (sea, mountains, gardens, etc). Leave out unless clearly true.

tags.description: Optional. A subset of the closed vocabulary listed here — see AGENT_PROMPT.md for what each tag means. Use only tags that clearly apply; do not guess. Never duplicate surface/access/indoorOutdoor/isScenic as a tag.

blurb.description: 1 to 6 paragraphs (separate paragraphs with one BLANK LINE), evocative but factual, no marketing superlatives, no invented history. See the style notes and two worked examples in AGENT_PROMPT.md / example.json.

isLocked.description: Leave this out unless you were explicitly told otherwise — it defaults to true (premium/locked) for every imported court, which matches this project's default.

isFeatured.description: Leave this out — it defaults to false. This is an editorial decision made later in the admin, not by the agent.

sources.description: 1 to 10 https:// URLs a human can open to check your work — the venue's official site first, then the page(s) you used for the description/coordinates. Not stored on the court; only used for review.

notes.description: Optional free-text note for the human reviewer, e.g. "coordinates approximate — venue has no exact pin". Not stored on the court; only used for review.
